verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a versioned REST API with an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, built for platform-to-platform integrations. It also offers a separate sandbox server, so programmatic, non-UI automation of the product is possible. However, API access is request-gated with manually issued credentials, and nothing documents a CLI, CI usage, or headless-runner workflows. Missing for 10: self-serve API credentials, an official CLI or headless runner, CI integration docs or examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of automated pipeline use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Our API was originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations.
Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document (info title "Puzzle Api", server https://app.puzzle.io/rest/v0) on its app domain
Sandbox Server: https://staging.southparkdata.com / Production Server: https://api.puzzle.io
